message.content: Li Hua measured the window for the installation of the curtain and provided the specific dimensions to Adam Smith. The window was found to be 150 centimeters wide and 120 centimeters high. These measurements were communicated via text message to ensure that Adam could order the curtains accurately to fit the space. This exchange is critical as it guarantees the proper fit of the curtains for privacy and aesthetic purposes in the basement window. The details of this exchange are found in the annotations tagged with the event ID "2" in the data table, where Li Hua confirms the measurements and Adam expresses gratitude for the precise details provided.
